verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native Slack, Notion, or Zapier connector for pushing notes. Fellow does offer generic building blocks: webhooks that POST when an AI note is generated, and a REST API exposing structured notes and action items. A team could use these to route notes into other tools with custom glue. The Slack mention in the evidence refers only to recording Slack Huddles, not to delivering notes into channels. Missing for 10: native Slack channel posting, a Notion page sync, an official Zapier app, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
